clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12263, whose subject line describes delegating strategic and critical materials transaction authority to the United States Trade Representative. The single paragraph delegates to the United States Trade Representative the functions vested in the President by section 5 of the Strategic and Critical Materials Transaction Authorization Act of 1979 in order to provide for the contribution of tin to the Tin Buffer Stock established under the Fifth International Tin Agreement. No earlier express end was found.
